T:P1.1.text: Bumble | Date, Chat & Meet New People

T:P1.2.text: Bumble is a social network that allows you to feel empowered while making connections, whether you're dating or looking for friends.

T:P1.3.text: We exist to bring people closer to love.

T:P1.4.text: We want our members to find meaningful and authentic relationships that ignite confidence and joy.

T:P1.5.text: Help shape the future of Bumble by joining our Member Circle. This select community of Members shares ideas directly with our team through chats, discussions, and product tests. Participants get early access to new features, sneak peeks at upcoming campaigns, and the chance to help make Bumble even better for everyone.

T:P1.6.text: Whether you're new to dating or ready to try again, Bumble Date is built to bring you closer to love safely and meaningfully.

T:P1.7.text: Whether you’ve moved to a new city or just want to expand your circle, BFF makes it easy to meet like-minded people who match your vibe.

T:P1.8.text: " We are both naturally positive, happy-go-getters, but when you put us together, it feels like there is nothing we can’t accomplish.

T:P1.9.text: Just scan the QR code to get started.

T:P2.1.text: About - Bumble | Date, Chat & Meet New People

T:P2.3.text: We believe love—in all its forms—is the foundation to a happy, healthy life.

T:P2.5.text: A member-first platform built to create kind, healthy connections.

T:P2.6.text: We started with one bold move. Today, we’re building the most trusted and effective place to find love.

T:P2.7.text: We flipped dating norms and gave women the first move.

T:P2.8.text: BFF launched to help people find their people. Because love is platonic, too.

T:P2.9.text: Serena Williams helped us bring women making the first move to the Super Bowl.

T:P2.10.text: We launched new functions to navigate dating during the Covid-19 pandemic.

T:P2.11.text: We went public—led by the youngest woman to ever do it.

T:P2.12.text: Alongside our anti-cyberflashing tech, we expanded our policies to protect women.

T:P2.13.text: We made the spotlight on women’s sports as bright as it should be.

T:P2.14.text: Now, we’re building a future where love feels possible for everyone.

T:P2.15.text: Our mission is to bring people closer to love.

C:P1.2.text: Match Group is the global leader behind Tinder, Hinge, and other leading dating brands, helping millions worldwide build meaningful connections.

C:P1.3.text: Powering Meaningful Connections at Global Scale

C:P1.4.text: Across cultures, communities, and every stage of life.

C:P1.5.text: Our Mission is to Spark Meaningful Connections for Every Single Person Worldwide

C:P1.6.text: We know that connection looks different for everyone, which is why we build and support a portfolio of brands, each designed to meet people where they are and help them connect in ways that feel right for them.

C:P1.7.text: The World’s Most Diverse Dating Portfolio

C:P1.9.text: We design experiences that meet people where they are — whether they’re exploring, seeking clarity, or looking for community.

C:P1.15.text: Created for Shared Culture and Community

C:P1.17.text: A global team building thoughtful, scalable solutions for modern connection.

C:P1.18.text: Match Group apps facilitate nearly half a billion matches every month.

C:P1.19.text: Designed to serve diverse communities across cultures and regions.

C:P1.20.text: Built into our apps to promote trust, accountability, and protection at scale.

C:P1.21.text: Trust and Safety Are Foundational to What We Do

C:P1.22.text: Connection only works when people feel safe.

C:P1.23.text: Meaningful connection starts with trust. Across our portfolio, safety, privacy, and user protection are built into how our products are designed and how our teams operate, from proactive detection to clear policies and ongoing investment in user trust.

C:P1.24.text: Thoughtful innovation guides how we approach AI.

C:P1.25.text: We believe generative AI can help create more engaging, inclusive, and safer experiences across our platforms. Our approach is grounded in responsible innovation, with a focus on transparency, accountability, and user trust.

C:P2.2.text: Match Group brings together a portfolio of brands designed to meet people where they are, whether they’re exploring, seeking clarity, or looking for community.

C:P2.5.text: Chief Legal & Corporate Affairs Officer and Secretary Match Group

C:P2.7.text: Head of Corporate Affairs Match Group

C:P2.8.text: Head of Trust & Safety Match Group

C:P2.9.text: 500 million matches are facilitated by Match Group's apps every month.

C:P2.10.text: 1/3 of marriages begin on an app.

C:P2.11.text: Behind every product are teams of people who care deeply about the impact of their work. Across brands, functions, and geographies, our teams collaborate to solve complex challenges around human connection.

C:P2.12.text: Sr. Manager, Globalization & International Growth, Product Operations

C:P2.13.text: Leading a global team across dozens of languages has pushed me to grow as a leader and think more strategically about how we connect people around the world.

C:P2.14.text: Every day, we’re working behind the scenes to remove bad actors so people have a real chance at finding meaningful connection. Ideally, users never know we exist — it just means we’ve done our job.
